title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
### **Description**

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to join us in our Pune office. An exceptional communicator capable of engaging stakeholders at all levels, you will carry out end-to-end recruitment activity across our various market-leading brands to ensure the business has the key talent it needs to compete and grow.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, negotiating offers, and onboarding. ·
* Strategic Sourcing: Develop and implement effective sourcing strategies to attract top-tier talent through job boards, social media, professional networks, and referrals.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs and design tailored recruitment strategies.
* Candidate Experience: Ensure a positive candidate experience by maintaining clear communication and a professional process.
* Talent Pipelining: Build and maintain a talent pipeline for key roles to meet future hiring needs.
* Data and Metrics: Track recruitment metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, quality of hire) and provide insights for continuous improvement.
* Employer Branding: Promote the company’s employer brand through various channels, including social media and industry events.
* Diversity and Inclusion: Implement strategies to increase diversity and ensure an inclusive hiring process. Recruitment
* Tools: Utilise our applicant tracking system (ATS), Pinpoint and other HR technologies to streamline the recruitment process.

### **About ParentPay Group**

At ParentPay Group, we believe that when schools run well, students thrive. That’s why we’ve spent decades building the operating system that supports well‑run schools – a seamless layer of tools, insights, and support that makes school life simpler for teachers, leaders, caterers, parents, and students alike.

From cashless payments and parent engagement to catering management, library systems, and MIS platforms, we connect the everyday parts of education through simple, secure, and connected tools. What began as a way to make school payments easier has grown into Europe’s leading EdTech group – trusted by over 20,000 schools and 9 million users across the UK and Europe.

Every day, our platforms process millions of payments, messages, and data points, quietly working in the background so schools can shine out front. Together, we’re helping schools save time, cut costs, and create more time for learning.

ParentPay Group is more than a collection of brands. We are a group of people dedicated to supporting well‑run schools and giving time back to teachers, parents, caterers, admin staff – and most importantly, to students.

description:
Job description

LEADT020833

on-site

Role

Lead Talent Acquisition Partner

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.

UKG is looking for a Lead Talent Acquisition Partner in Pune to drive value-driven hiring for its product, technology & G&A organization, partnering with senior global leaders across region. This is a senior individual contributor role for a professional who combines strong stakeholder management, talent market intelligence, and hands-on expertise in AI-enabled recruiting to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**About the role**
==================

The Lead TA Partner owns hiring outcomes for a global portfolio of roles spanning product, engineering, and G&A functions. The role operates as a strategic partner to senior leaders across regions, translating business priorities into hiring plans, advising on talent market trade-offs, and ensuring every hire creates value for the business.

The Lead TA Partner also leads recruiting projects that change how the global team works: piloting and scaling AI-enabled tools and automation, embedding structured and repeatable processes, and bringing data storytelling into leadership conversations. The role serves as a go-to resource for the team on stakeholder management, market insights, and AI in recruiting, and is expected to lead complex, business-critical searches with confidence.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Drive value-driven, end-to-end hiring for global product, engineering, and G&A roles, delivering on time, on quality, and aligned to business goals.
* Act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to senior leaders across the region, aligning hiring priorities, challenging assumptions, and guiding decisions on market trade-offs, compensation positioning, and location strategy.
* Manage complex, multi-region stakeholder groups with confidence, adapting approach across time zones, hiring cultures, and business contexts.
* Lead recruiting projects and initiatives end to end, from scoping and stakeholder buy-in through adoption and impact measurement, in areas such as AI sourcing and screening pilots, structured interviewing, intake and SLA frameworks, and hiring manager enablement.
* Evaluate, pilot, and scale AI-enabled tools and automation across sourcing, screening, scheduling, candidate engagement, and reporting, with measurable gains in turnaround time and recruiter capacity, while safeguarding fairness, candidate experience, and data privacy.
* Build and nurture proactive global talent pipelines for critical and recurring skills; identify alternative talent pools, geographies, and adjacent profiles when traditional sources cannot meet demand.
* Provide leaders with timely talent market intelligence on availability, skill scarcity, compensation benchmarks, and the competitive landscape, and use it to shape hiring strategy and long-term workforce plans.
* Use funnel data, systems reporting, and market insights to influence hiring decisions; act as the team's trusted advisor in data storytelling and translate insights into clear, compelling narratives for leadership.
* Develop a strong understanding of UKG's products, customers, and the HCM industry, and connect recruiting strategies clearly to business and team priorities.
* Identify and implement process improvements that raise hiring speed, quality, interview consistency, and the experience for candidates and hiring managers.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and team resource on process, tooling, AI, and stakeholder management; coach peers through challenging situations and reinforce best practices across the global team.
* Lead complex, niche, or business-critical searches where role ambiguity or talent scarcity requires a customized approach.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10–15 years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with a substantial portion in SaaS, enterprise software, or product-led technology companies.
* Proven experience partnering with and advising senior stakeholders across global, distributed teams and multiple time zones, with a strong record of stakeholder management and influence.
* Demonstrated track record of value-driven hiring outcomes: quality of hire, offer-acceptance, hiring manager satisfaction, and time-to-fill for product and technology roles.
* Hands-on expertise using AI in recruitment, such as AI-assisted sourcing, candidate matching and screening, outreach personalization, interview intelligence, or generative AI for recruiting content and analysis, with the ability to articulate measurable impact and lessons learned.
* Experience leading recruiting projects or initiatives end to end, from defining scope and securing buy-in through adoption and measurement.
* Strong data and business acumen; comfortable with funnel metrics, dashboards, and market data, and able to turn them into a persuasive story for leaders.
* Deep knowledge of modern sourcing techniques, global talent market mapping, and competitive intelligence for technology talent in India and internationally.
* Proficiency with enterprise ATS and CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruiting analytics tools.
* Excellent communication, consulting, and influencing skills; able to challenge thinking constructively and operate with a high degree of autonomy.
* Preferred: experience recruiting for HCM, HR tech, or workforce management products; exposure to global hiring programs, employer branding, or talent intelligence; experience mentoring recruiters.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.

About SpazioLiv

SpazioLiv is a rapidly growing interior design and home solutions brand committed to transforming living spaces through innovation, quality, and exceptional customer experiences. As we continue to scale, we are looking for an experienced and results-driven Lead Talent Acquisition professional to drive our recruitment efforts and build high-performing teams across the organization.

Role Overview

The Lead Talent Acquisition will be responsible for managing the organization's entire recruitment function, ensuring timely closure of positions while maintaining high hiring quality standards. This role requires a strategic recruiter with strong stakeholder management, sourcing expertise, employer branding capabilities, and deep experience in scaling teams across functions.

The ideal candidate should have 4-5 years of hands-on recruitment experience with a proven track record of hiring across corporate, sales, operations, design, and leadership roles.

Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Acquisition & Recruitment

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for all business functions across the organization.
* Develop and execute hiring strategies to meet current and future workforce requirements.
* Manage the complete hiring lifecycle including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiations, and onboarding coordination.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Drive volume hiring as well as niche and leadership hiring requirements.

Stakeholder Management

* Partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers to understand hiring needs.
* Act as a recruitment advisor to stakeholders on market trends, talent availability, and hiring best practices.
* Ensure alignment between recruitment strategies and business objectives.

Sourcing & Talent Mapping

* Leverage multiple sourcing channels including LinkedIn, Naukri, job boards, referrals, social media, networking, and headhunting.
* Build proactive talent pools for future hiring requirements.
* Conduct competitor mapping and market intelligence to identify top talent.

Recruitment Operations

* Track and improve key hiring metrics such as TAT, offer-to-join ratio, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness.
* Ensure recruitment processes are efficient, scalable, and candidate-centric.
* Maintain recruitment dashboards and present hiring reports to leadership.

Employer Branding

* Strengthen SpazioLiv's employer brand across digital platforms.
* Drive employee referral initiatives and recruitment marketing campaigns.
* Participate in industry networking events and talent engagement programs.

Team Leadership

* Mentor and guide junior recruiters and talent acquisition team members.
* Establish recruitment best practices and process improvements.
* Ensure high standards of candidate experience and hiring quality.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 4-5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment independently.

Key Skills

* Leadership Hiring
* Volume Hiring
* Stakeholder Management
* Talent Mapping & Market Research
* LinkedIn Recruitment & Boolean Search
* Employer Branding
* Interviewing & Assessment
* Offer Negotiation
* Recruitment Analytics
* Team Management
* Excellent Communication & Influencing Skills

Preferred Experience

* Experience in high-growth startups, interior design, retail, real estate, consumer services, or similar industries.
* Hands-on experience with ATS platforms and recruitment automation tools.
* Strong network of industry professionals and passive candidates.

Success Metrics

The successful candidate will be measured on:

* Hiring targets achieved within defined timelines.
* Quality of hires and retention rates.
* Reduction in time-to-fill positions.
* Candidate experience scores.
* Offer acceptance rates.

title: Contract Recruiter (6 months)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------

At OpenGov, finding the right people to drive revenue and deliver for our customers starts with a great sourcing engine. As a Contract Recruiter focused on GTM, you’ll be the first point of contact for candidates pursuing Sales and Professional Services roles in India — building pipelines, sparking conversations, and qualifying talent before passing it to the recruiting team. You will also support other functions like Engineering, Product, and Security when needed, while keeping the primary focus on GTM hiring. **Based in Pune on a 6-month contract,** you’ll partner closely with our TAs to keep hiring moving fast, especially during high-volume hiring drives where interview coordination becomes just as critical as the outreach itself. If you’re energized by the hunt, love a great candidate conversation, and take pride in keeping things organized and on-time, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Source candidates proactively** using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and creative outbound tactics — identifying both active and passive talent that matches the profile for each requisition.
* **Conduct initial phone and video screens** to assess candidate interest, communication quality, compensation expectations, and basic role fit before passing qualified candidates to the Recruiter.
* **Maintain a healthy, organized pipeline** on Ashby, keeping candidate records, outreach status, and screen notes updated so the recruiting team always has a clear view of where candidates stand.
* **Coordinate interview scheduling** during hiring drives — managing candidate and interviewer calendars, sending confirmations, and ensuring a smooth, on-time interview experience for all parties.
* **Draft and send personalized outreach messages** to passive candidates that reflect OpenGov’s mission and the opportunity at hand, balancing volume with authenticity to maximize response rates.
* **Collaborate daily with the Recruiter**, sharing pipeline updates, flagging blockers, and aligning on sourcing priorities as requisition needs shift.
* **Serve as a positive brand ambassador** in every candidate interaction, ensuring that even candidates who aren’t a fit walk away with a strong impression of OpenGov.
* **Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency.**

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of sourcing or talent acquisition experience in a SaaS, technology, or staffing environment, or equivalent work experience
* Demonstrated ability to source and engage candidates for GTM functions such as Sales (SDRs) or Professional Services (Implementation Engineers)
* Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and at least one ATS platform for pipeline tracking and candidate management
* Strong written communication skills — able to craft outreach that gets responses and represents the brand well
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage candidate pipelines and interview schedules simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience sourcing GTM talent specifically in the Indian market, with familiarity with the Pune talent landscape and local compensation norms
* Prior experience with Ashby or a similar ATS
* Background in high-volume or hiring-drive environments where speed and coordination are equally important
* Familiarity with GovTech, enterprise SaaS, or public sector software — helpful context for qualifying candidates on role and mission fit

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions
  

**Role Purpose**
----------------

The Talent Acquisition Manager - India will lead recruitment strategy and delivery across Corning India, supporting talent needs across Manufacturing, Engineering, Technology, R&D, Commercial, Corporate Functions, and Leadership hiring.

This role serves as a strategic talent partner to business leaders and HR teams, responsible for workforce planning, recruitment execution, employer branding, talent market intelligence, and recruitment operations. The incumbent will lead hiring initiatives that support business growth, manufacturing expansion, organizational transformation, and future workforce scaling while ensuring an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.

As part of Corning's Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence, the role will also contribute to regional and global talent acquisition initiatives, best practices, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Talent Acquisition Strategy & Business Partnership**

* Develop and execute the India Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Partner with business leaders and HR teams to forecast talent needs and build effective hiring strategies.
* Provide talent market intelligence, competitive insights, and workforce planning recommendations.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on recruitment, talent availability, and hiring best practices.

**Recruitment Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment across all functions and levels, including manufacturing, engineering, technology, R&D, commercial, corporate, and leadership hiring.
* Ensure delivery of hiring targets, service levels, and workforce commitments.
* Personally lead critical, hard-to-fill, and executive-level searches where required.
* Support large-scale hiring initiatives related to business growth, expansion projects, and organizational transformation.

**Operations & Vendor Management**

* Oversee Talent Acquisition operations, recruitment processes, and governance across India.
* Manage RPO partners, recruitment agencies, and external talent suppliers to ensure high-quality delivery.
* Monitor recruiting metrics, budget utilization, sourcing effectiveness, and hiring performance.
* Drive process improvements through the effective use of ATS, CRM, and recruitment technologies.

**Employer Branding & Talent Attraction**

* Strengthen Corning's employer brand through targeted attraction strategies and market engagement.
* Lead campus recruiting, graduate hiring, internship programs, and early-career initiatives.
* Build sustainable talent pipelines through partnerships with universities, industry associations, and talent communities.
* Collaborate with HR and Communications teams to enhance Corning's employee value proposition.

**Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain recruitment analytics, dashboards, and workforce planning metrics.
* Analyze hiring trends, sourcing performance, and recruitment effectiveness to support business decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on hiring quality, candidate experience, and operational efficiency.

**Projects & Transformation**

* Support talent acquisition activities related to expansion projects, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and workforce transformation initiatives.
* Participate in regional and global TA projects, capability-building programs, and implementation of new recruiting tools and best practices.

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree required.
* Master's Degree or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience within multinational organizations.
* Proven success leading recruitment across manufacturing, engineering, technology, commercial, corporate, and leadership functions.
* Experience managing recruitment teams, RPO providers, and agency partners.
* Strong background in workforce planning, employer branding, campus recruitment, and large-scale hiring programs.
* Exposure to regional or global recruitment environments is preferred.

**Experiences/Education - Desired**
-----------------------------------

* Strong Talent Acquisition leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term planning and operational execution.
* Expertise in workforce planning, talent analytics, and recruitment technologies.
* Strong project management, problem-solving, and change management skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and presentation abilities.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple business units, geographies, and stakeholders.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* Approximately 20-30% domestic travel within India.
* Occasional international travel as required
